text: Recent visitor feedback highlights ongoing issues with crowding and parking that affect the overall experience. Several reviews mention difficulty navigating the space due to lack of clear directional signage and long waits at interactive exhibits, which rely heavily on AI technology. Some visitors also reported problems with ticket purchasing, including payment methods and unclear accessibility information. While many appreciate the building’s architecture and the amount of information available, the crowded conditions and limited gift shop options have led to dissatisfaction among some guests. Addressing these operational challenges could improve visitor satisfaction.
